questions.question: [For you as product thinker; queued R2 of 5. On your last note: you asked for the layout work to travel with the asking work.] I propose three parts: (1) the layout rules go into the universal-patterns chapter, (2) the question check refuses a badly built question, and (3) the interview pages carry the same rules. For example, a criteria walk would show the criterion before asking whether it stands. Do you confirm this routing, or would you route it differently?

options.label: Confirm
options.preview: Route as proposed: the layout rules, the check and the interview pages travel together as one bundle.

options.label: Change one part
options.preview: Keep the bundle, but move one of the three parts elsewhere; you say which.

options.label: Route differently
options.preview: Route the layout work on its own, apart from the asking work.
